topic: The one test your AI agent's audit log needs to pass
caption:
Would your AI agent's audit log survive a surprise check 👀

Pick any resolution it closed last week.
Could you say exactly what it saw, what it decided, and what happened after.

Most teams can't. Their log just says a ticket got closed. That's activity, not proof. 💡

A proof grade log tracks four things every single time: the real input, the action taken, any human help, and a result check days later. 📊

Skip one of those and the log still looks full. It just can't back up the number on your dashboard.

Save this and run the test on your own log before finance does. Comment TEST if you want our audit checklist. 💬
